prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone photographic thumbnail for a website category called "water scene illustration"; not a detection result or a customer case.
Primary request: a bright, natural Chinese urban river or lakeside scene viewed from a gently elevated oblique angle. A broad stretch of calm ordinary water occupies most of the center and foreground, with a believable pale blue-green-gray appearance under daylight. A narrow landscaped shoreline with sparse natural grasses and small patches of reeds follows one side. In the distance, a modest contemporary concrete bridge or riverside embankment infrastructure provides a realistic city-river context.
Composition/framing: landscape photograph approximately 1000 by 680 pixels, aspect ratio about 1.47:1. Slightly top-down oblique perspective, medium-wide view, clear water surface as the main subject. Include shoreline and enough distant infrastructure for context while keeping the image simple and suitable for cropping as a small website thumbnail.
Style/medium: convincing professional outdoor documentary photography, natural water texture and subtle reflections, real concrete and plant textures, restrained saturation, clear bright summer daylight. No dramatic cinematic effects, no artificial glassy water, no futuristic architecture.
Constraints: this is a generic river/lake environment illustration, not a specific outfall, water-quality diagnosis, pollution evidence, measurement image or model output. No conspicuous pollution plume or waste, no exaggerated electric-blue water, no coloured diagnostic effects, no heatmaps, no annotations, no detection boxes, no interfaces, no diagrams, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no readable signage, no drone in the scene.
limitations: AI-generated generic river/lake environment illustration; not a customer case, specific outfall, pollution assessment, water-quality measurement or model output. Parent owns visual review and website cropping verification.
